title: Seven Candidates Vie for Tocantins Governorship in 2026 Elections
subtitle: Voters in Tocantins will have seven names to choose from to lead the state in the upcoming election.
excerpt: Seven candidates are running for Tocantins governor in the 2026 elections, with over 1.1 million eligible voters set to cast their ballots.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
For the 2026 elections, the state of Tocantins will see seven candidates vying for the governorship. The contest will be decided by over a million voters, with 1,182,307 individuals eligible to cast their ballots.

What's at Stake

The governor will be chosen by direct vote of the Tocantins population, following the electoral calendar set by Brazilian legislation. Each candidate presents their platform to the electorate, who will decide at the polls who will take over the state's administration.

How the Electoral Process Works

The electoral calendar outlines the stages leading up to the vote, including candidate registration, campaigns, and the election date. The number of eligible voters – 1,182,307 – underscores the significant citizen participation anticipated.

  • Seven candidates are vying for the governorship of Tocantins;
  • 1,182,307 voters are eligible to cast their ballots;
  • The election will take place as part of the 2026 electoral calendar.

The outcome will determine the state's political and administrative direction for the next four years.

With information from Agência Brasil.
